title_sq: Tek Shkolla E Kuqe, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ideale Per Investim!!!
description_sq: Prane Pazarit te Ri shitet apartament 1+1 me lokacion ideal. Prona ka nje siperfaqe bruto prej 61.3 m2, nga ku 54 m2 eshte siperfaqe neto dhe 7.6 m2 siperfaqe e perbashket. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares, dhoma e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit, tualeti. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati 7-katesh, ne faze shtrimi, me sistem kapot, ashensor, sistem kondicionimi, sistem termik. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje nder zonat me te kerkuara te Tiranes si dhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
title_en: Near the Red School, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in an ideal location near the New Market. The property has a gross area of ​​61.3 m2, of which 54 m2 is net area and 7.6 m2 is common area. The apartment is organized by the distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen corner, the bedroom, the toilet. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 7-story building, in the construction phase, with hood system, elevator, air conditioning system, thermal system. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana and offers all the facilities for a comfortable life.
